November is officially #NationalDiabetesMonth.

In South Texas, where our rate of diabetes is twice the national average, we must do everything we can to lower treatment costs and prevent this disease.

https://t.co/yEAocb7D5w.

South Texas has one of the highest rates of diabetes in the nation — 18% above the national average.

This #WorldDiabetesDay, we must raise awareness about this disease and continue to increase access to vital diabetes care and diagnosis.

South Texas, don’t miss out on January coverage! I encourage everyone to sign up and find an affordable healthcare plan that is right for you!

Today marks 15 years since the passage of the #AffordableCareAct. Just in the last decade, this landmark law has provided healthcare coverage to 50 million Americans and has protected more than 133 million with pre-existing conditions. Let’s continue to fight for affordable healthcare!

At a time when egg prices are reaching record highs, grocery bills are hurting wallets, and American families are barely getting by, the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) is in danger of being defunded by House Republicans.
 
SNAP helps struggling South Texans and Americans by:

🥗 Helping kids, seniors, and veterans access high quality, nutritious food
🧑‍🌾 Investing in America’s farmers and ranchers
🏥  Allowing families to afford their rent, utilities, or medical care

Medicaid is one of our most important tools in fighting poverty. Recently, House Republicans passed a budget that would gut Medicaid and leave our most vulnerable Americans without healthcare. I will always fight to protect Medicaid coverage for South Texans! https://t.co/xOKQcacJJb

Team Gonzalez had the pleasure of joining the 5th Annual Douglas Youth Center Health & Wellness Drug Free Walk of Kingsville. Step-by-step, we are raising awareness for a healthier, drug-free South Texas! https://t.co/5LAHrFGV7V

Thank you to all the South Texas nurses who serve our community! We recognize nurses for their service and dedication to caring for others and improving the health of patients nationwide. #ThePowerOfNurses https://t.co/PaSK4fVlXH

My team had the pleasure to meet with Omar Rodriguez from the Food Bank of the Rio Grande Valley to discuss the importance of funding for food and nutrition programs. With South Texans struggling to put food on the table, SNAP cuts will only raise grocery bills, make it harder to access nutritious foods, and support farmers & small businesses.
Lorena and I are holding Former President Joe Biden, Dr. Jill Biden, and their entire family in our hearts and prayers as we learn of his cancer diagnosis.

Team Gonzalez had a great time at the Nopalitos Wellness Run this morning!  Keystone is doing amazing work across our district and the state. Our team thanks Anh Nguyen from the Keystone team and all the runners for inspiring our community to live healthier, more active lives! https://t.co/v9NFlzVstS

Since 1965, Medicare and Medicaid have provided high-quality affordable healthcare for millions of Americans, including hundreds of thousands of South Texans. However, the Trump Administration and Republicans have passed the One Big, Ugly Bill to strip 17 million Americans of their healthcare coverage, including 1.6 million Texans just to satisfy the desires of the ultra-rich.

Rest assured that I will continue to fight and protect high-quality affordable healthcare for ALL! I will not stand for this injustice. Our abuelitos, abuelitas and our children deserve to be treated with the same respect.

I joined the members of the @AFSCME to highlight the damaging impacts that cuts to Medicare, Medicaid, the Affordable Care Act, and SNAP will have on South Texas families, children, veterans, and senior citizens. https://t.co/lQUwpILGIh

Let's call the Big, Ugly Bill what it is—a cold and calculated attempt to strip South Texans of their hard earned benefits, healthcare, and our children access to nutritious meals, sometimes the only food they receive a day.

Despite promises to lower everyday costs for American families, actions have proven otherwise. Thanks to the Republican's One Big, Ugly Bill, costs will continue to increase in areas like healthcare and food assistance.
